recognize_zh: 抹片中可見數個核呈腎形、摺疊或分葉的單核球系細胞，細胞質灰藍、帶細小空泡，並伴隨淋巴球；在 GATA2 家族先證者（CMML）的背景下，提示單核球系增生與異常。
features: Medium-to-large monocytoid cells with folded, reniform or lobulated nuclei
Moderately fine chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuolation and scant fine granules
One cell with a round nucleus and pale, finely granular cytoplasm (monocyte/promonocyte range)
Interspersed small mature lymphocytes; clumped red cells and platelet-rich background
describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained smear (likely bone marrow aspirate) shows several monocytic cells with folded, reniform and lobulated nuclei, fine to moderately condensed chromatin and abundant grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, admixed with small lymphocytes. Some monocytic forms have irregular nuclear contours, but unequivocal promonocytes or blasts are not numerous in this field. Blast enumeration and dysplasia assessment require a full differential count. In the clinical context of the GATA2 proband with CMML, findings are consistent with a monocytic proliferation.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytes are mature and lack dysgranulopoiesis, and the monocytosis is transient without cytopenias or clonal abnormalities.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: AML requires at least 20% blasts plus promonocytes with fine chromatin and nucleoli, whereas this field shows mostly mature-appearing monocytes.
aCML is dominated by dysplastic neutrophils and their precursors with monocytes usually below 10%.
